limitations: This is fixed alpha=.5 interpolation of task-trained native anchors and source-selected endpoint best1 weights; it is not a new training epoch, a zero-shot foundation-model interpolation or an output ensemble.
External datasets have already been viewed as development data. No untouched blind-test, significance or universal mechanism claim is supported.
Each family has different prior training history; cross-family context is not an isolated normalization effect.

Preparation and strict-load metadata record259 learned tensors averaged,152 BN moments averaged,76 counters copied and9 constructor-fixed buffers copied. This independent CPU audit did not reload checkpoint tensors to certify their contents.
The prior implementation report contains three synthetic CPU tests; they were not rerun as part of this completed-score audit and do not replace native checkpoint evaluation.
Source and external scoring retains all declared inputs; the native float32 target and failure-error1 conventions are preserved. RF100 scalar targets were derived offline from four-point annotations.

Previously audited original anchors, full fine-tuning and CNN-fixed predictions are reused as saved paired references without additional GPU work, old GT recomputation, alpha search or checkpoint search.
